subject: CTO dry-run and presence for Stratonics demo
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@stratonics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@stratonics.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask - CTO presence for Oct 28 demo

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for working with us on the upcoming product walkthrough. We're dialing in logistics for the Oct 28 slot and Rahul (our CTO) asked whether he should be on the call for the exec portion. He prefers a short, focused session where we cover: technical architecture, data privacy controls, and latency/throughput expectations.

Can you confirm if Redwood can allocate 20-30 minutes with a senior engineer + one exec (you or a technical lead) during the demo? Also would you be able to do a 20–30 minute dry run a day before (Oct 27) to run through the runbook and Q&A handoffs?

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Oct 28, 10:00–11:00
- Oct 28, 14:00–15:00

If Rahul can join, he prefers the morning. Let me know who will be the primary Redwood presenter and whether you can do the dry run.

Thanks,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Engineering
Stratonics
[Attachment: vendor-rfp-summary.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@stratonics.com>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@stratonics.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask - CTO presence for Oct 28 demo

Sanjay —

Great, thanks for the clarity. We can support Rahul joining for a focused 25-minute exec segment. Proposed plan: 45-minute product demo + 25-minute exec Q&A (technical deep-dive) where I and one senior engineer cover architecture and performance.

We can hold the demo at 10:00 PT on Oct 28 (fits Rahul's morning preference). For the dry run, I'm available Oct 27 between 15:00–17:00 PT for a 30-minute run-through. If that window doesn't work for your team, suggest two alternative 30-min windows and we'll adapt.

I'll be the primary presenter for the architecture/perf portion; Ava will handle onboarding/integration questions, and Monica will handle procurement/next steps. Quick asks from our side for the dry run:
- Confirm Rahul's preferred talking points (security vs performance weighting)
- Share any specific test prompts or workload examples you want us to run live

I've attached a short agenda and our runbook draft for the dry run. I'll send the calendar invites once you confirm the times.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: agenda-stratonics-demo.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@stratonics.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask - CTO presence for Oct 28 demo

Karthik / team —

Quick note: Monica and I will join both the dry run and the demo for handoffs. Monica, can you slot procurement next steps immediately after the demo (10:55–11:10 PT) so we keep momentum?

I attached the roles-and-runbook.md with a simple responsibilities matrix and the runbook.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
